linework.observation: Clean outlines define crew, consoles, map table, gauges and watertight door.

colour.observation: FAIL: intense saturated red light fills nearly every compartment surface and turns indicators into a neon wash, outside the restrained palette.

shading.observation: Cel shading is visible, although broad red illumination adds excessive glow and contrast.

character_construction.observation: World-scene crew have normal faces and hair; no bald protagonist appears.

backgrounds.observation: Enclosed sonar or control room with multiple crew stations and map table.

finish.observation: Well-drawn equipment and faces, but global red illumination competes with readable forms.

identity.observation: No protagonist appears, as required in this supporting-only scene.

content.observation: Crew working at consoles and a shared chart fit a submarine watch setting.

composition.observation: High wide view establishes the room and crew activity.

regions.people_faces: Supporting crew have hair and distinct profiles; no protagonist appears.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls across the working crew.
regions.foreground_props: Radar screens, map table and clipboards.
regions.architecture: Enclosed steel room with pipes, equipment banks and a watertight hatch.
regions.distance: Several crew stations layer through the room and remain legible.
regions.lighting: Global red glow is too saturated; use mostly neutral cream task lights with only dim localized indicators.

correction: Keep the same crew at their watch stations and the chart table. Replace the room-wide red lighting with subdued cream work lights, charcoal and muted steel; keep only a few small, dim red status lamps. Preserve the enclosed submarine room, supporting crew with hair, composition and clean cel-shaded outlines.
